scenario: Position rule per LREG.2.3 — `where` clause requires a pattern with zero capturing groups. A `where`-position pattern that contains captures rejects; the diagnostic should point at converting captures to `(?:...)` non-capturing groups or moving to a `let` form. Pin: `where m.text ~ /(\w+)/` rejects with DS_VALIDATE_REGEX_WHERE_HAS_CAPTURES.
rules_ds:
schema Msg scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    text: String mutable

rule trig:
    Msg m where m.text ~ /(\w+)/
->
    log info "x"
